clue.text: Disputes about the din made by certain birds

indicators.note: the disputes go about, enclosing, the word for din

parts.note: to spar is to argue, so disputes are spars
a row is a loud noise or din

explanation.surface: Squabbling birds raise a racket in a hedge.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparrows are small brown songbirds, one particular kind of bird.

clue.text: Putting drink by, make a meal

parts.note: to sup is to drink
per means by, as in per post

explanation.surface: Set a drink aside and prepare dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Supper is an evening meal.

clue.text: Dropped since involved in a plot

indicators.note: the word for since is put inside the plot word

parts.note: a bed is a garden plot
as can mean since or because

explanation.surface: Someone fell, having become caught up in a conspiracy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plot' looks like a conspiracy but is a patch of garden.
explanation.definitionFit: To be abased is to be lowered in rank or esteem, humbled.

clue.text: Frame some revolutionary work

parts.note: red is the colour associated with revolutionaries and communists
an act is a deed or piece of work

explanation.surface: Set up a piece of rebellious writing.
explanation.definitionFit: To redact is to draw up or put into form, so to frame in words.

clue.text: Dryad's methyl alcohol

definitions.meaning: methanol, formerly made by distilling timber

explanation.surface: A tree nymph's preferred strong drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A dryad is a nymph of the forest; methyl alcohol was once distilled from timber.

clue.text: Venerable cedars in bad shape

indicators.note: something in bad shape is out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ancient revered cedar trees are looking unhealthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something venerable is revered and holy, treated with religious respect.

clue.text: A non-professional group, mature as can be

indicators.note: the letters show what they can be when rearranged

explanation.surface: An unpaid club is as grown-up as possible.
explanation.definitionFit: Amateurs are people who take part in an activity for pleasure, not pay.

clue.text: Telling connection

definitions.meaning: the act of narrating, a recounting

explanation.surface: A revealing link between two things.
explanation.definitionFit: A relation can be a narration or account; it can also be a link or kinship.

clue.text: Set off for school in time

indicators.note: the school goes inside the time word

parts.note: a date is a point in time
Eton is a famous English public school

explanation.surface: Leave promptly for classes.
explanation.definitionFit: To detonate is to set off an explosive.

clue.text: Quiet form of adornment-really sweet

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical direction for quiet
an eardrop is a pendant earring, a piece of jewellery

explanation.surface: A subtle piece of jewellery is described as really charming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sweet' reads as praise for the jewellery but is the definition: a pear drop is a boiled sweet, a British confectionery.
explanation.definitionFit: A pear drop is a pear-shaped boiled confection flavoured with pear essence.

clue.text: Sort of dance where everyone lay around

indicators.note: the word for lay goes around the word for everyone

parts.note: to lay money is to wager it, a bet
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A dance after which all the dancers lie on the floor.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballet is a theatrical dance form performed to music.

clue.text: A duty carrying the queen's train

indicators.note: the tax word carries, holding within it, the queen's letters

parts.note: excise is a duty or tax on goods
ER (Elizabeth Regina) stands for the queen

explanation.surface: An official obligation to bear the monarch's long ceremonial gown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' looks like the queen's gown but is the definition, a verb meaning to drill or practise.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise and to train both mean to drill the body or mind through practice.

clue.text: Modern, not retrogressive, as a man of science

parts.note: new means modern

indicators.note: going backwards, so the word not is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A scientist described as up to date and forward-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: Isaac Newton was the English physicist who formulated the laws of motion and gravity.

clue.text: Note strain induced when it's over-loud

indicators.note: the letters are brought into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A musical note becomes forced when sung too loudly.
explanation.definitionFit: Stentorian means extremely loud and powerful, like the herald Stentor's voice.

clue.text: Produce youngsters left without shelter and he'll just drop everything

parts.note: animals litter when giving birth to a brood
out means outdoors, without cover

explanation.surface: A creature gives birth outdoors with no cover, then abandons everything.
explanation.walkthrough: A litter lout is British slang for someone who drops rubbish in public places.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who carelessly discards rubbish in public is described with this insult.

clue.text: Among the Greek heroes there are ones without eminence

definitions.text: Among the Greek heroes there are ones without eminence

parts.words: Among the Greek heroes there are ones without eminence
parts.note: a hero of the Trojan war whose name, spoken loosely, sounds like a phrase for being without a hill or high ground

explanation.surface: Some Homeric heroes were not distinguished at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eminence' means high ground, not fame; the name of a Greek warrior said casually sounds like 'a hill-less'.
explanation.definitionFit: Achilles was the foremost Greek warrior at Troy in Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: An odd escort for an older person!

indicators.note: odd means strange, so the letters are put in a strange order

explanation.surface: An unusual companion for an elderly person.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancestor is someone from whom you descend, of an earlier generation.

clue.text: A dog with 11 7 ways

parts.note: 11 across is exercise, and PE (physical education) is exercise
7 down is relation, and kin are relations
east, south and east are directions or ways on a compass

explanation.surface: A dog with relatives exercising in several directions.
explanation.walkthrough: The numbers point to other answers in the grid: 11 is EXERCISE and 7 is RELATION. The Pekinese is a small Chinese lapdog.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pekinese is a small long-haired toy breed of canine from China.

clue.text: Handy, and that's a point in the retreat

indicators.note: the first pieces go inside the word for retreat

parts.note: a convent is a religious retreat for nuns
ie (id est) means that is
N (north) is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Something useful found at a quiet religious house.
explanation.definitionFit: Convenient means close at hand, easy to use or reach.

clue.text: Stay, setting serving men on edge

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: RE (Royal Engineers) are soldiers in service
a side is an edge

explanation.surface: Remain, putting servants on a precarious brink.
explanation.definitionFit: To reside is to stay or live in a place.

clue.text: The warning sound of some gliders

definitions.text: The warning sound of some gliders

parts.words: The warning sound of some gliders
parts.note: gliders suggests aircraft, but here it means snakes, one kind of which shakes its tail to warn

explanation.surface: An alarm from unpowered aircraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gliders' suggests aircraft; here it means snakes, which glide along the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A rattle is the buzzing noise the rattlesnake makes with its tail as a warning.

clue.text: Many aren't to be changed, so it's discovered

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral fifty, a large number

indicators.note: the letters of the next word are to be altered in order

explanation.surface: Many things should not be altered, so it has been found out.
explanation.definitionFit: Learnt means found out or came to know.

clue.text: Some would describe rising early as a bloomer!

indicators.note: only part of the following words is used, a run within them

explanation.surface: People say getting up early is a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a mistake, but here it is a flowering plant: Iberis is the candytuft.
explanation.definitionFit: Iberis, candytuft, is a garden plant grown for its flowers.

clue.text: A way speed can be controlled

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner of doing
rate means speed

explanation.surface: A method by which velocity is regulated.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderate means restrained, kept within reasonable limits.

clue.text: The landlord's correspondence

definitions.meaning: a written message sent by post

explanation.surface: Mail sent by the owner of a rented house.
explanation.definitionFit: A landlord is one who lets property; correspondence is a written message posted to someone.

clue.text: A clergyman-one in the church

indicators.note: one goes inside the church word

parts.note: a minster is a large church
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A priest is a single figure inside a cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: A minister is a member of the clergy in Protestant churches.

clue.text: Ordered and maybe stored

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Goods arranged neatly and perhaps put away.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sorted has been arranged or put in order.

clue.text: The diversion of profits

definitions.meaning: money earned on a loan or deposit

explanation.surface: Money skimmed off from company earnings.
explanation.definitionFit: A hobby or pastime is a diversion; returns paid on money lent are profits.
